description_en: Queries all tags that are bound to a data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeTagKeys接口查找一个迁移、同步或订阅实例绑定的所有标签
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-tag-keys --page-size 20 --page-number 1 --resource-type ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE --resource-id dtsl5o11f9029c0000 --category Custom --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTagKeys

parameters.help_en: The number of tag keys to return on each page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 当标签值过多时，选择一次返回的个数，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. This parameter is used together with PageSize. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，通常与PageSize搭配使用，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE
parameters.help_zh: 系统服务规定参数，固定取值为：ALIYUN::DTS::INSTANCE
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移、同步或订阅的实例ID，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html接口查询
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The tag type. Valid values:
System: tags created by the system.
Custom: tags added by users.

If this parameter is left empty, publicly visible tags are returned by default
parameters.help_zh:
标签类型，取值：
System：系统创建的标签。
Custom：用户添加的标签。

当值为空时，默认返回可公示的标签
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS实例所属的地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of tags returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of tag keys
